LogLevel.//Microsoft.AspNetCore: Warning is load-bearing on this site, not tidiness. ASP.NET's hosting diagnostics log every request line at Information, and on /angebot/{token} the request line contains the customer's token — a credential (Architecture.md §12). Raising this to Information would write a live token into every log sink. The API's appsettings.json holds the same level for the same reason.
LogLevel.//System.Net.Http.HttpClient: Defence in depth alongside Program.cs's RemoveAllLoggers(). IHttpClientFactory's own handlers log 'Sending HTTP request GET {uri}' at Information, and every URI this Website requests contains the customer's token. This category sits outside Microsoft.AspNetCore, so the level above does not cover it.

PublicApi.//: Where this Website reaches the RenoTrack API. Deployment-specific, so no value is committed; the Development value is supplied through Properties/launchSettings.json, which is tracked and machine-independent. Required, and validated as an absolute HTTPS URL: the customer's token travels in this request's path.
PublicApi.//TimeoutSeconds: How long one API call may take before the customer sees the 'temporarily unavailable' page. Defaults to 10 if absent — unlike BaseUrl, a timeout has a safe default, which is the policy itself.

CompanyIdentity.//: Customer-facing company identity. No value is committed and none is invented (Phase 11 Q7): the real name and contact details are supplied before the completion gate, as Email:FromAddress and TokenLink:PublicBaseUrl already are. Absence is a startup warning, not a failure — this is copy, not wiring, and the page omits the heading rather than showing a placeholder a customer might mistake for a real name.

TrustedForwarders.//: The proxies whose X-Forwarded-* headers this Website believes (ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md D97). Empty means trust nothing, which is the default and the safe one: an unconfigured deployment behaves exactly as it did before D97 rather than believing a header any caller can set. Populate with the real reverse proxy at deployment time.
